old_caption:
The video begins with a static shot of two triangular structures made from interlocking blocks, one cyan and one pink, placed on a wooden surface against a plain white wall. The cyan structure is composed of smaller blocks, while the pink structure is larger and more complex. In front of these structures lies a long line of dominoes, alternating in color between gray and pink. The scene is calm and orderly.

The dominoes begin to fall, initiating a chain reaction. The dominoes fall in a cascading effect, sending waves of movement across the wooden surface. As the dominoes topple, the cyan triangular structure collapses first, followed by the pink triangular structure, each collapsing into a heap of scattered blocks. The cyan and pink blocks remain visually distinct in the resulting pile. The camera remains static throughout the entire clip.
original_wisa_caption:
The video begins with a static shot of two triangular structures made from interlocking blocks, one blue and one pink, placed on a wooden surface against a plain white wall. The blue structure is composed of smaller blocks, while the pink structure is larger and more complex. In front of these structures lies a long line of dominoes, alternating in color between gray and pink. The scene is calm and orderly.

Suddenly, the video captures a moment where the dominoes are knocked over, causing a chain reaction. The dominoes fall in a cascading effect, sending waves of movement across the wooden surface. As the dominoes topple, they knock over the triangular structures, causing them to collapse into a heap of scattered blocks. The blue and pink blocks mix together, creating a chaotic scene of disarray. The camera remains stationary throughout, focusing on the entire sequence of events, capturing the dynamic transition from order to chaos.
caption:
On a pale wooden tabletop against an off-white wall, a domino arrangement stands in two full triangular pyramids, a left one of teal-and-gray tiles and a right one of pink-and-gray tiles. A long horizontal row runs along the bottom edge. A central vertical stem capped by a Y-shaped pair of diagonal branches rests between two clear acrylic barriers, with a teal open loop at left and a small pink arch at right.

While the right part of the bottom row falls, the pyramids hold briefly before their upper and left portions lean. Top tiles peel away and tumble outward, scattering onto the table to the left of each structure. Gaps open across the triangles as the collapse advances continuously onward. The right pyramid sheds its left-side columns toward the central gap. The left part of the bottom row, the vertical stem, the diagonal Y-branches, the teal loop and the pink arch remain in place. The topple is still underway.
